scope: One deterministic degree-five control for the already built native quotient checker; no n51 or LFD-six claim.
fixture_rule: N=8, D=5; quotient coordinates evaluate on the first 73 Boolean points of weight at most 3, ordered by weight then mask; one generator is x0*x1*x2*x3.
reason: The degree-at-most-three monomials evaluated on the selected points contain a 73 by 73 triangular submatrix, so the map is onto. The degree-at-most-four space has dimension 163, giving a low kernel of dimension 90. Evaluation commutes with every Boolean variable multiplication, and the degree-four generator vanishes on every selected point.
decision_rule: Only exact exit-zero agreement with every expected field, plus a separate Python checker agreement, qualifies this D5 control. Any mismatch leaves D5 qualification unknown.
concurrency: Fixture is 5,288 bytes and reuses a built checker; no second frontier producer or high-memory reservation. Run alongside the existing n51 D5 job only if live host memory and budget gates pass.
freeze: Commit and verify GitHub revision before the one checker attempt. Preserve stdout, stderr, exit, and hashes; no retry.
